source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Find a length when the scale's end is broken or the zero mark is not clear.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Cannot measure from the 2 cm mark; it must start at 1 cm.

intelligence.enrichment: A scale with a broken end or unclear zero can still be used by placing one end of the object at another clear full mark and using the separation between the readings at the two ends. nonzero starting mark plus endpoint reading -> length found from the difference between readings The learner correctly applies this rule: A scale with a broken end or unclear zero can still be used by placing one end of the object at another clear full mark and using the separation between the readings at the two ends. The far endpoint reading on a scale is always the object length.
